hooks.text: This launch could be your lock screen
hooks.action: hold the phone up to the camera with the launch photo on screen

hooks.text: A new space photo every single day?
hooks.action: point at the launch on screen, then look at the camera

hooks.text: Watch me find today's space photo
hooks.action: open the app on camera as you say it

hooks.text: Two taps and this is your wallpaper
hooks.action: tap twice on the phone screen toward the camera

lines.say: Example Orbit is paying me to show you this.
It shows a new space photo every day.
I've opened it every morning this week to see the new one.
You can save any photo as your phone wallpaper in two taps.
Honestly it's the best space app out there.
Download Example Orbit, link in bio.
